rubrics.semantic_rubric: Specific shared object, identifiable part/action/relation or named material/region at BOTH marked patches. Generic color/edge/orientation or broad animal/furniture umbrella is not enough. State the shared meaning.
rubrics.visual_rubric: Separately judge shared specific texture/form/color/material/geometric structure. Parts and cross-category geometry are valid visual concepts; do not use category labels as unit names.
rubrics.unavailable: Missing or zero-positive pairs must be unclear
